name: Stage 30: Djupviksvägen to Åbo
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 30, Djupviksvägen to Åbo.
utilities: Official area: Katrineholms kommun, Nyköpings kommun.

Official distance is 11 km from Djupviksvägen to Åbo; the local official-GPX route is about 10.5 km, Äventyrligare reports 10.74 km, OSM relation 3117090 sums to about 11.1 km including short spurs but is tagged 13 km, and Naturkartan prose/older imports can still say about 13 km. Use 11 km official and treat 13 km as stale metadata.

The stage has a remote, self-sufficient character with no settlements on-route: Djupviksberget/Stenstorps hagkärr reserve context, Rudgölen/Övre Ålsjön rest/swim/tent context, Vikitteln, Vikittelns minikanjon, Vensbrinksberget/Skogsbyås tower, rolling/hilly forest terrain and the Åbo transition.

Vikitteln is the only main shelter/rest cluster on stage 30. It has shelter, several fire/grill places, simple bathing/jetty context and a dry-toilet context supported by Skogsbyslingan/OSM rather than the stage-30 icon list.

Parking is better south of Fagerön bridge, at Djupvik/Stenstorps hagkärr, Skogsbyås/Skogsbyslingan, or cautiously at Åbo than exactly at the stage boundary. The stage 29/30 transition itself is not a guaranteed trailhead parking place.

Public transport is weak. Djupvik/Fagerön bus context may help near the north end when running, Skogsbyås has no regular bus connection, and Åbo mainly has pre-booked complementary traffic or onward access by continuing to Stavsjö.
waterSources: The source about 1 km northwest of Åbo at 58.781283, 16.359550 is official but explicitly marked uncertain quality; filter/boil/treat.
The Åbo cold spring at 58.775700, 16.366800 is official and near the stage end/stage 31 start. Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or flow, so treat/filter/boil.
Lake water at Rudgölen, Övre Ålsjön and Vikitteln is natural/bathing water only, not a potable refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official stage warning remains published: bark-beetle/windfall risk between Skogsby/Skogsbyslingan parking and Vikitteln shelter, with trees over/near the trail and trees that may fall easily. Avoid this area during or shortly after strong wind.
Stenstorps hagkärr reserve forbids camping and fires; dogs must be leashed and plants may not be picked except berries/edible mushrooms.

Djupviksberget protects living/dead standing or fallen trees, shrubs, plants, fungi and lichens, with limited own-use berries, edible mushrooms and flowers allowed. Organized camps/competitions may require Länsstyrelsen permission.

Skogsbyås does not list a general individual tent/fire ban online, but protects living/dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi and lichens and requires permission for organized camp activity/competitions. At Skogsbyås/Vikitteln, bring your own legal fuel/wood if fire is allowed; dead or living wood may not be taken and fire bans/brandrisk override prepared fireplaces.

A few tents can fit at Rudgölen/Övre Ålsjön according to official text. Vardagstur's 2022 report describes a small point/islet rest spot with fire ring, a couple of flat tent spots and hammock trees but no wood box. Treat as an informal low-impact tent/rest option, not a maintained campsite; no shelter, toilet, bin or official fire facility is guaranteed there.
Vikitteln shelter is free/first-come and cannot be booked. Reports mention useful grill/cooking tools, but do not assume tools/pans, trash bins, supplied firewood or empty shelter space.

User reports add practical cautions: meltwater was reported in February 2024 but passable, Åbo-side clearcuts/bark-beetle terrain can make path/waymark finding harder, and Vensbrinksberget/Skogsbyås has rocky exposed footing where poles may help.

Åboravinen on the continuation into stage 31 has a separate stronger reroute/windfall warning; it is beyond stage 30 but important for through-hikers and should not be treated as a Stage 30 on-route hazard.

Do not import Skogsbyslingan, parking connectors, water-source stubs, Åbo spring micro-spurs, the Skogsbyslingan parking stub or the Rudgölen/Övre Ålsjön access stub into the Stage 30 main route. Draw the continuous Djupviksvägen-Åbo line only.

OSM relation 3117090 connects cleanly to Stage 29 near 58.824786, 16.342178 and Stage 31 near 58.776228, 16.365952, but contains several non-mainline stubs. Snap the through-line to those shared nodes for continuity while keeping official labels and water/service markers separate.
AllTrails and some translated services may render Åbo as Turku; this is Åbo near Stavsjö in Sörmland, not Åbo/Turku in Finland.

facilities.name: Djupviksvägen stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start. Do not assume parking exactly at the stage 29/30 transition; use nearby signed/roadside options such as Fagerön bridge or Djupvik/Stenstorps hagkärr.

facilities.name: Fagerön bridge parking for stage 30
facilities.description: Practical parking south of the Fagerön bridge, about 800 m back along stage 29 from the stage 30 start. Check signs and avoid blocking access.

facilities.name: Djupvik / Stenstorps hagkärr parking
facilities.description: Alternative reserve parking about 1.5 km west/northwest of the stage start; Länsstyrelsen reports about five cars and bus access to Djupvik. Useful for Djupviksberget/Stenstorps hagkärr access, not exactly the trailhead.

facilities.name: Fagerön / Djupvik bus context
facilities.description: OSM maps paired Fagerön stops at the stage-start road and a confirmed Djupvik stop near the reserve parking; Länsstyrelsen confirms bus access from Katrineholm to Djupvik. Treat as limited and verify live Sörmlandstrafiken service.

facilities.name: Fagerön bridge access services
facilities.description: Off-stage/access cluster near the Stage 30 parking/backtrack approach: OSM maps toilet and waste basket nearby, with beach/rest/firepit context farther north on Fagerön. Do not treat as a core Stage 30 facility.

facilities.name: Djupviksberget reserve warning
facilities.description: Reserve/Natura 2000 highlight with limestone conifer forest, orchids and rare flora/fungi. Do not damage living/dead standing or fallen trees/shrubs, or collect/damage plants, fungi or lichens except limited own-use berries, edible mushrooms and flowers; organized camps/competitions may require permission.

facilities.name: Stenstorps hagkärr rules
facilities.description: Reserve context on/near the early stage: no camping, no fires, dogs leashed, and no plant picking except berries/edible mushrooms.

facilities.name: Rudgölen rest/swim context
facilities.description: Rudgölen lake/rest/swim context from official Stage 30 text. Natural lake water only, not a potable source; no verified shelter, toilet or bin.

facilities.name: Övre Ålsjön tent/rest context
facilities.description: Official text says Rudgölen/Övre Ålsjön have rest/swim opportunities and room for a few tents. A 2022 hiker report describes a small rest point with fire ring, a couple of flat tent spots and hammock trees, but no wood box. Treat as informal low-impact tenting, not a maintained campsite; check exact reserve boundary and avoid Stenstorps hagkärr.

facilities.name: Övre Ålsjön swim/rest context
facilities.description: Informal lake swim/rest context confirmed by official text and trip reports. Not a municipal bathing place or drinking-water point.

facilities.name: Övre Ålsjön firepit
facilities.description: OSM-mapped firepit near Övre Ålsjön. Not listed as an official Stage 30 fireplace; use only if current fire rules allow, and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Vikitteln shelter
facilities.description: Vikitteln shelter/rest cluster. Official stage text places the shelter after about 6.5 km and gives a coordinate slightly east; OSM names the actual shelter node slightly west at this pin. Free/first-come shelter; no booking, guaranteed firewood, tools/pans or trash service.

facilities.name: Vikitteln fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fire/grill cluster by Vikitteln; Skogsbyslingan text says several grill places. Bring your own firewood if fire is allowed; Skogsbyås reserve forbids taking dead or living wood, and fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Vikitteln dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet by the Vikitteln shelter cluster, supported by Skogsbyslingan toilet icon and OSM/local context rather than the Stage 30 icon row. A 2024 wasp-nest comment was later reported removed; verify condition on arrival.

facilities.name: Vikitteln toilet wasp note resolved
facilities.description: Official comments reported bees/wasps at the toilet on 2024-08-10/11; the stage manager replied on 2024-09-13 that the nest was removed on 2024-09-12 and the toilet was usable again. Keep as historical inspect-on-arrival context only.

facilities.name: No verified Vikitteln bin
facilities.description: No bin was verified at Vikitteln or elsewhere on the Stage 30 core route. Pack out all waste; do not borrow Fagerön beach bins into the on-stage shelter model.

facilities.name: Vikitteln bathing/rest
facilities.description: Simple lake bathing/rest by the shelter area. Not a municipal sampled beach or potable-water source.

facilities.name: Vikittelns minikanjon
facilities.description: Geological mini-canyon/cave area roughly 500 m after Vikitteln and near Skogsbyslingan. Approximate OSM/Mapcarta-aligned pin.

facilities.name: Skogsbyås windfall warning
facilities.description: Official warning area between Skogsby/Skogsbyslingan parking and Vikitteln shelter: bark-beetle-damaged spruce, trees over/near the trail, and trees that may fall easily. Länsstyrelsen also notes bark-beetle attacks in Stenstorps hagkärr, Djupviksberget and Skogsbyås. Avoid during or shortly after strong wind.

facilities.name: Vensbrinksberget / Skogsbyås tower
facilities.description: Södermanland's highest point, 123 m above sea level, with a 12 m observation tower. Strongly confirmed by Sörmlandsleden, Länsstyrelsen and OSM; tower can feel exposed in wind.

facilities.name: Skogsbyås / Skogsbyslingan parking
facilities.description: Reserve/loop parking for Skogsbyslingan, Vikitteln, minikanjon and Vensbrinksberget. Länsstyrelsen says there is no bus connection and easiest access is by car/gravel road from Stavsjö/E4.

facilities.name: Skogsbyås viewpoint after parking
facilities.description: Official stage text mentions a fine viewpoint about 900 m after Skogsby tower parking; OSM has a viewpoint node in this direction. Optional viewpoint marker, not a facility.

facilities.name: Åbo-side clearcut wayfinding caveat
facilities.description: A 2022 hiker report described Åbo-side clearcut/bark-beetle terrain where both path and markers sometimes needed searching. Use offline map/GPS and current orange markings.

facilities.name: Stage 30 meltwater caveat
facilities.description: Official 2024 comments reported much meltwater on trail/stream but passable despite trees over the path. Treat as seasonal wet-footing context, not a current closure.

facilities.name: Stage 30 OSM stub caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 3117090 contains non-mainline stubs for Åbo spring/water, Skogsbyslingan parking, Rudgölen/Övre Ålsjön and the Åbo approach source. Keep these as markers/spurs, not part of the continuous route line.

facilities.name: Spring 1 km northwest of Åbo
facilities.description: Spring about 1 km northwest of Åbo. Official coordinate is 58.781283, 16.359550 and explicitly says uncertain quality; OSM spring node is about 20 m away at this app pin. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Åbo stage transition/info board
facilities.description: Practical stage-end/stage-31-start context near the OSM information board. Official stage 31 start coordinates align nearby.

facilities.name: Åbo cold spring
facilities.description: Åbo cold spring near the stage 30/31 transition. Official coordinate is 58.775700, 16.366800; OSM spring node is about 20 m away at this app pin. Natural untreated source; verify flow and treat/filter/boil.

facilities.name: Åbo parking context
facilities.description: Official stage text says parking exists at Åbo, but capacity/formality is unclear. Länsstyrelsen Åboravinen says parking is along the road where the trail crosses and larger parking is planned. Treat as roadside/local parking and check signs.

facilities.name: Åbo complementary transit context
facilities.description: No reliable turn-up-and-go transit found at Åbo. Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic lists the Skogsby, Fridhem, Åbo, Kråkviken, Lövdalen and Stavsjö area; book by 16:00 the weekday before via Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Djupviks kursgård off-route lodging
facilities.description: Official Sörmlandsleden lodging listing still includes Djupviks kursgård for Etapp 29/30, about 700 m by shortcut or 1.5 km from the stage board. Verify before relying; do not infer public all-hours toilet, tap, bin or food service.

facilities.name: Åboravinen continuation warning
facilities.description: Beyond stage 30 on the stage-31 continuation: official/Länsstyrelsen warning and reroute context for bark-beetle/windfall risk. Important for through-hikers continuing south.
